# Sofia Sans fixtures

`sofia.css` is the Google Fonts stylesheet fetched with a Chrome user agent on 20/11/2026. [Google Fonts CSS source](https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Sofia+Sans:wght@400;600;700&family=Sofia+Sans+Extra+Condensed:wght@700;800&display=swap)

Copyright 2019 The Sofia Sans Project Authors (https://github.com/lettersoup/Sofia-Sans)

The fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. [Full license text](OFL.txt)

If the Google Fonts CSS URL in `index.html` or `track.html` changes, fetch the new URL with a Chrome user agent and save the response as `sofia.css`. Download each distinct `fonts.gstatic.com` WOFF2 URL referenced by the CSS into this directory using its URL basename. Keep the URLs in the CSS and remove fixture files that it no longer references.
